newsitem.title: FRANCE: PRESS DIGEST - FRANCE - LE MONDE MARCH 12.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - FRANCE - LE MONDE MARCH 12.

text.p: These are leading stories in
afternoon daily Le Monde.
FRONT PAGE
-- Traffic to be cut by half in Paris on days of heavy
pollution.
BUSINESS PAGES
-- The terms and conditions for the privatisation of
Thomson-CSF published today says it expect electronics
hub to develop around Thomson-CSF. There are no restrictions on
the nationality of potential bidders, bidders need at least five
billion francs equity to be eligible. The successful bidder to
be chosen by June 30.
-- Aerospatiale [AERP.CN] to be excluded from bidding for
Thomson-CSF in alliance with Alcatel Alsthom on
grounds that Aerospatiale is a state-owned company.
-- Renault European staff demonstrate at
Billancourt Paris suburb against planned plant shut-down and job
cuts. EU parliamentarians join in criticism.
-- French chemicals industry expects three percent growth in
activity in 1997.
-- Chargeurs International posts 136 million
francs profit for 1996, partly due to restructuring.
-- Lafarge to intensify international development.
-- Paris Newsroom +33 1 42 21 53 81
